items.name: init
items.title: DX Design System — init
items.description: Installs DX tokens (CSS variables for 3 brands × 4 color modes × 2 densities, Tailwind v4 theme, shadcn/ui aliases), the cn() helper and fonts. Install this first. Set <html data-brand data-theme data-density> to switch.

items.name: agents
items.title: AI assistant rules
items.description: AGENTS.dx.md: rules for AI coding assistants (use DX components and tokens, theming, icons, accessibility). Reference it from AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md.

items.name: app-shell
items.title: App shell
items.description: AppShell (skip link, header, sidebar with nav items), PageHeader and ThemeSwitcher for Next.js App Router.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Button — triggers an action.

items.name: icon-button
items.title: Icon Button
items.description: Icon Button — a square button with only an icon (row actions, toolbars, close, overflow menus).

items.name: link
items.title: Link
items.description: Link — navigates to another page or resource. Always underlined so it is identifiable without color.

items.name: text-field
items.title: Text Field
items.description: Text Field — single-line text input with label and helper text.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Select — choose one option from a list (select-only combobox; no typing to filter).

items.name: select-option
items.title: Select Option
items.description: Select Option — one row inside a Select Menu (listbox option). States: Default, Hover, Selected (brand-subtle + check), Disabled. Reused later by Menu (v0.5).

items.name: select-menu
items.title: Select Menu
items.description: Select Menu — the open listbox shown under a focused Select (4px gap). Elevation/2, radius/md. Override option labels and states on the nested Select Option instances; add or remove rows as needed.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Combobox — a text field you can type into to filter a list, then pick one option (ARIA 1.2 combobox, list autocomplete).

items.name: combobox-option
items.title: Combobox Option
items.description: Combobox Option — one row in the Combobox Menu. Same states as Select Option; Active = the option highlighted with the arrow keys (aria-activedescendant) — DOM focus stays in the input, so it gets a background + 2px brand bar, not a focus ring, Selected = the committed value (check).

items.name: combobox-menu
items.title: Combobox Menu
items.description: Combobox Menu — the listbox that opens 4px under a focused Combobox. Content: Results (matches bolded; Focus = highlighted with arrow keys) · Recent (empty query) · Loading (async search, show after 300ms) · No results (say what was typed + what to try) · Create (offer to add the typed value). Show keyboard hint for first-run or power-user surfaces. Max height 320 then scroll; width = field width.

items.name: date-field
items.title: Date Field
items.description: Date Field — type a date or open the Calendar from the calendar button. Pair with Calendar (popover, 4px below) to make a Date Picker.

items.name: calendar-day
items.title: Calendar Day
items.description: Calendar Day — one cell of the Calendar grid (40×40 hit area, 32px circle).

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: Calendar — month grid that opens in a popover under Date Field (Date Picker), or sits inline on booking pages.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Textarea — multi-line free text (comments, descriptions, feedback).

items.name: search-field
items.title: Search Field
items.description: Search Field — single-line search with a search icon and clear button.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Checkbox — select zero, one or many independent options.

items.name: radio
items.title: Radio
items.description: Radio — pick exactly one option from a small, visible set (2–5). Always used in a group with a visible group label.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: Toggle — switch a single setting on or off with immediate effect (role=switch).

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Slider — pick a value (Single) or a range (Range) on a continuous scale where the exact number matters less than the position: volume, price filters, zoom.

items.name: slider-thumb
items.title: Slider Thumb
items.description: Slider Thumb — the handle. 20px visual, 40px hit area in code.

items.name: chip
items.title: Chip
items.description: Chip — compact selectable token for filters and tags.

items.name: file-upload
items.title: File Upload
items.description: File Upload — drop zone for attaching files.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Alert — an inline, persistent message about the page or a section (also called banner or callout).

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Toast — a brief, non-blocking confirmation that appears in a corner (bottom-right or bottom-center) and goes away.

items.name: progress-bar
items.title: Progress Bar
items.description: Progress Bar — determinate progress.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Skeleton — a placeholder that mirrors the shape of content while it loads.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: Spinner — indicates that something is in progress when its duration and shape are unknown.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty State
items.description: Empty State — explains why a space is empty and what to do next.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Tooltip — a short text label that appears on hover or keyboard focus of a control.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Badge — short, non-interactive status or category label (1–2 words).

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Dialog — a modal window that interrupts the page for a decision or a short focused task.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Popover — small floating panel anchored to a trigger.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: Drawer — full-height side panel over the page.

items.name: menu-item
items.title: Menu Item
items.description: Menu Item — one action inside a Menu.

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: Menu — a list of actions that opens from a trigger (usually an Icon Button "More" or a Button with a Chevron Down).

items.name: nav-item
items.title: Nav Item
items.description: Nav Item — one destination in the Sidebar.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: Sidebar — primary app navigation, used together with the App Header.

items.name: skip-link
items.title: Skip Link
items.description: Skip Link — first focusable element on every page (WCAG 2.4.1). Hidden until it receives keyboard focus, then appears top-left above the App Header; Enter moves focus to <main>. Shown here in its focused state.

items.name: app-header
items.title: App Header
items.description: App Header — the top bar of every app screen. Height = layout/header-height (64 Desktop / 56 Tablet+Mobile).

items.name: breadcrumbs
items.title: Breadcrumbs
items.description: Breadcrumbs — shows where the page sits in the hierarchy. Up to 2 ancestor Links (exposed) + the current page (plain text, aria-current="page"). <nav aria-label="Breadcrumb">. Hide on Mobile when the back path is obvious; never more than 4 levels.

items.name: page-header
items.title: Page Header
items.description: Page Header — the top block of a page's content area: optional Breadcrumbs, title (the page's only H1 in code), description and page-level actions.

items.name: tab
items.title: Tab
items.description: Tab — one item in a Tabs bar. Selected tabs use color/text/brand with a 2px brand indicator; unselected use text/secondary.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Tabs — switch between related views of the same content without leaving the page.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented Control
items.description: Segmented Control — pick one of 2–5 related options that change how the same content is shown (view, period, filter). Selection applies immediately.

items.name: segmented-control-item
items.title: Segmented Control Item
items.description: Segmented Control Item — one segment. Use inside Segmented Control; don't place on its own.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: Stepper — shows where someone is in a linear, multi-step flow (onboarding, checkout, setup) and lets them go back to finished steps.

items.name: step
items.title: Step
items.description: Step — one step of a Stepper. Use inside Stepper.

items.name: accordion-item
items.title: Accordion Item
items.description: Accordion Item — one collapsible section.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Avatar — represents a person or workspace.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Card — container grouping content and up to two actions about one subject.

items.name: divider
items.title: Divider
items.description: Divider — a 1px rule that separates groups of content.

items.name: list-item
items.title: List Item
items.description: List Item — one row in a simple list (members, files, notifications). Replaces hand-built rows from the v0.4.1 agent test.

items.name: table-header-cell
items.title: Table Header Cell
items.description: Table Header Cell — column header. Sort: None (sortable, unsorted) · Ascending · Descending · Not sortable.

items.name: table-cell
items.title: Table Cell
items.description: Table Cell — one cell in a data table row. Types: Text · Two-line · Avatar (person) · Badge (status) · Numeric (right-aligned, tabular) · Checkbox (row selection, 48px) · Actions (Icon Button "More", 64px).

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Pagination — moves through pages of a table or list. Summary text (what is shown) + previous/next Icon Buttons (Secondary, Small; Disabled at the ends) + current page. <nav aria-label="Table pagination">; announce the new range in a polite status message after paging.

items.name: form-section
items.title: Form Section
items.description: Form Section — groups related fields under a title and description inside long forms and settings pages.

items.name: error-summary
items.title: Error Summary
items.description: Error Summary — shown at the top of a form after a failed submit when there is more than one error.

items.name: form-actions
items.title: Form Actions
items.description: Form Actions — the buttons that submit or cancel a form.

items.name: ai-response
items.title: AI Response
items.description: AI Response — an answer written by AI, with its disclosure, sources and controls.

items.name: ai-label
items.title: AI Label
items.description: AI Label — discloses that content was made or changed by AI. Generated (accent) | Edited (neutral, after a person edits it). Always visible on AI output; never hidden in a tooltip. Code: <AILabel type="generated" />

items.name: citation
items.title: Citation
items.description: Citation — a numbered source behind an AI answer. A link: opens the source, with an accessible name like "Source 1: Leave policy 2026". Put them right under the claim they support.

items.name: ai-confidence
items.title: AI Confidence
items.description: AI Confidence — how sure the system is, in words + icon (never colour alone). High (sources agree) · Medium (partial support) · Low (check before using). Only show when the model gives a real signal.

items.name: stat-card
items.title: Stat Card
items.description: PRODUCT KIT (SaaS admin) — not Core. Stat Card — one key number on a dashboard.

items.name: auth-01
items.title: A centered sign-in card
items.description: Email and password with show/hide, an error summary that links to each field, remember me, single sign-on and a magic-link option.

items.name: auth-02
items.title: A split sign-in screen with a brand panel
items.description: The form on one side, a brand panel with a customer quote on the other. The panel hides below 1024px.

items.name: auth-03
items.title: Sign up with password rules
items.description: Name, work email and a password with live rules (length, number, letter) announced politely, terms consent, and single sign-on.

items.name: dashboard-01
items.title: Dashboard with key numbers, a chart and a table
items.description: An inset sidebar app: four key numbers with trends, visitors over time with a range switch, and a sortable table of documents.

items.name: dashboard-02
items.title: Analytics overview with tabs
items.description: A header-only layout: top navigation, a date-range action, tabs for Overview / Analytics / Reports, key numbers, monthly revenue and recent sales.

items.name: dashboard-03
items.title: Field operations dashboard
items.description: For agriculture and field teams: today's weather, alerts that need action, task progress by crew, and a table of fields with crop, stage and moisture.

items.name: dashboard-04
items.title: Project overview
items.description: One project at a glance: owner and team, overall progress, milestones as a stepper, workload per person, and recent activity.

items.name: data-table-01
items.title: Tasks table with search, filters and bulk actions
items.description: Search, status filter chips, sortable columns, row selection with a bulk-action bar that announces the count, and pagination.

items.name: data-table-02
items.title: Invoices table with column picker and row actions
items.description: Choose which columns to show, a "More" menu on each row, status badges, a totals row and export. Scrolls sideways inside its frame on small screens.

items.name: empty-state-01
items.title: First use: no projects yet
items.description: What's empty, why, and one way forward — plus three templates to start from and an import option.

items.name: empty-state-02
items.title: No search results
items.description: Keeps the search and filters in view, says what matched nothing, suggests fixes and offers to clear everything in one step.

items.name: empty-state-03
items.title: All caught up
items.description: A good empty: the inbox is clear. Says so calmly, shows when it was last updated, and offers related places to go.

items.name: empty-state-04
items.title: No access, with a request form
items.description: Explains why the page is hidden and who can help, then lets the person ask for access with a note. Confirms the request without leaving the page.

items.name: settings-01
items.title: Account settings with section navigation
items.description: Profile, preferences and notifications as form sections, with an in-page section list that stays in view and a sticky save bar once something changes.

items.name: settings-02
items.title: Team and billing settings
items.description: Tabs for General, Members and Billing: workspace details, a members table with roles and invites, the current plan with usage, and invoices.

items.name: sidebar-01
items.title: A simple sidebar with sections
items.description: Documentation-style navigation: product and version switcher, search, and links grouped under section labels.

items.name: sidebar-02
items.title: A sidebar with collapsible sections
items.description: Section labels open and close their links, so long navigation stays short. The section with the current page starts open.

items.name: sidebar-03
items.title: A sidebar with submenus
items.description: Each section shows its pages underneath, indented on a guide line. Good for docs with two levels.

items.name: sidebar-04
items.title: A floating sidebar with submenus
items.description: The same two-level navigation in a floating card with a gap around it, for lighter app chrome.

items.name: sidebar-05
items.title: A sidebar with collapsible submenus and search
items.description: Search on top; each section opens with a plus and closes with a minus. Only the section you're in starts open.

items.name: sidebar-06
items.title: A sidebar with submenus as dropdowns
items.description: Sections open a menu of their pages beside the sidebar instead of expanding in place. An upgrade card sits at the bottom.

items.name: sidebar-07
items.title: A sidebar that collapses to icons
items.description: Workspace switcher, collapsible sections, projects and an account menu. Collapses to a 72px icon rail (Ctrl/⌘ + B); a drawer on phones.

items.name: sidebar-08
items.title: An inset sidebar with secondary navigation
items.description: The page sits in a raised card beside the sidebar. Main sections, projects, support links and the account menu.

items.name: sidebar-09
items.title: Nested sidebars: an icon rail and a list
items.description: A mail-style layout: folders in a 72px rail, the messages of the selected folder in a panel next to it. Collapsing hides the panel and keeps the rail.

items.name: sidebar-10
items.title: A workspace sidebar with page actions in a popover
items.description: Notes-app layout: workspace switcher, quick links with an unread count, favorites, nested workspace pages, and the page's own actions in a popover in the header.

items.name: sidebar-11
items.title: A sidebar with a collapsible file tree
items.description: Changed files on top, the project's folders below. Folders open and close; files are links.

items.name: sidebar-12
items.title: A sidebar with a calendar
items.description: Account menu on top, a month calendar, and calendars you can show or hide. A wider sidebar (320px) so the calendar fits.

items.name: sidebar-13
items.title: A sidebar in a dialog
items.description: A settings dialog with its own section navigation. On phones the sections become a list above the content.

items.name: sidebar-14
items.title: A sidebar on the right
items.description: An "On this page" sidebar on the end side of the screen, with the toggle at the end of the header.

items.name: sidebar-15
items.title: A left and a right sidebar
items.description: Workspace navigation on the left, a calendar panel on the right (from 1024px). The left one collapses; the right one stays.

items.name: sidebar-16
items.title: A sidebar under a sticky site header
items.description: A full-width header with the toggle, breadcrumbs and search stays on top; the sidebar sits below it.

items.name: theme-mangrove
items.title: Brand · Mangrove
items.description: The “Mangrove” brand for DX (Plus Jakarta Sans, primary #2f7d4f). Passes 108/108 contrast checks across light, dark and both high-contrast modes. Set <html data-brand="mangrove">.
